headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Rust Integration
summary: By integrating Rust capabilities, ClearInstall can offer more robust and secure package management. Utilizing Rust for critical components will improve performance and reliability, making it a more attractive choice for developers looking to mitigate risks during the installation process.
actions: Integrate Rust-Anything (9065) to support Rust bindings and ensure compatibility with Rust-based projects.
Adopt VIctory (8957) for UI improvements, enhancing user experience by providing a more intuitive interface for managing local-first lockfiles.
Implement xcl (6744) for advanced command expansion checks, ensuring that all potential risks related to binding.gyp commands are thoroughly audited.
